allow: PowerShell($env:PORT=3100; Start-Process -FilePath "npx" -ArgumentList "next dev -p 3100" -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput "$env:TEMP\\devout.log" -RedirectStandardError "$env:TEMP\\deverr.log"; Start-Sleep -Seconds 12; Get-Content "$env:TEMP\\devout.log" -Tail 8)

PowerShell($pids = \(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen\).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; foreach \($id in $pids\) { Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$id" | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, @{n='Cmd';e={$_.CommandLine}} | Format-List })
